note: Showroom feed — every image features real products SDLR installs, and each caption names the selections so followers can DM to get the look. Shot mix this week: coastal pool & spa statement, Mediterranean outdoor kitchen amenity, desert-modern twilight fire, aerial sport court, and a Trust & Difference post built around the 10-Month Walk-Through. Neighborhoods rotate La Jolla, Rancho Santa Fe, Mount Helix, 4S Ranch, Del Mar. Post natively in the Instagram app.

posts.alt: La Jolla coastal hillside backyard with a rectangular pool, glass-tile spa spillway and silver travertine deck framed by olive trees and an ocean view at golden hour
posts.hook: The pool is the easy part. Where it sits is the design.
posts.caption:
The pool is the easy part. Where it sits — framed by the olives, open to the water, the spa turned to catch the last of the light — that's the design.

A La Jolla hillside gives you one thing most yards don't: a horizon. Everything here is arranged around it.

The selections:
• Arizona Tile silver travertine decking
• glass-tile spa with spillway
• Diamond Spas water feature
• FX Luminaire landscape lighting
• mature olives, agave & Mexican feather grass

Have a view worth building around? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Rancho Santa Fe Mediterranean outdoor kitchen under a StruXure louvered pergola with a Lynx grill, stainless cabinetry and Belgard paver patio at golden hour
posts.hook: The louvers open for the sun and close over the smoke. That's the whole idea.
posts.caption:
A real outdoor kitchen isn't a grill pushed against a wall. It's a room you can cook in for three hours and never want to leave.

The StruXure pergola tilts its louvers to the sun through the afternoon, then closes over the cooktop so the smoke goes up instead of into the conversation. Stainless that shrugs off the coast. Stone that reads like the house it belongs to.

The selections:
• StruXure louvered pergola
• Lynx built-in grill
• Danver stainless cabinetry
• Belgard Dimensions pavers
• olive trees & terracotta plantings

Want a kitchen you actually host from? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Mount Helix desert-modern backyard fire lounge with a long board-formed concrete fire feature and drought-tolerant planting against valley hills at twilight
posts.hook: The best seat in the house faces the hills, not the TV.
posts.caption:
East county has a trick coastal yards don't: at dusk the hills go violet and the whole valley quiets down. Build the fire to face it and you'll never sit anywhere else.

A long, low run of flame. Concrete you can set a drink on. Seating deep enough to lose an evening in.

The selections:
• Warming Trends CrossFire burner
• board-formed concrete fire feature
• Techo-Bloc Blu 60 pavers
• FX Luminaire path lighting
• agave, aloe & ornamental grasses

Want a place to end the day like this? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Aerial view of a 4S Ranch backyard with a blue-and-green VersaCourt pickleball court bordered by SYNLawn turf and Belgard pavers, a tile-roof home and chaparral hills behind
posts.hook: From above you can see the whole plan: play on one side, host on the other.
posts.caption:
From the air it's obvious — a yard that does two jobs at once. Court on one end, a full patio to host from on the other, turf softening the space between so it never feels like a parking lot.

A regulation pickleball court fits smaller lots than most people think. Get the layout right and it settles into the yard instead of taking it over.

The selections:
• VersaCourt pickleball surface
• SYNLawn artificial turf
• Belgard paver patio & borders
• built-in grill island
• olive trees & drought-tolerant grasses

Wondering if a court fits your yard? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Del Mar coastal-contemporary covered patio with an ipe wood ceiling, Belgard porcelain pavers, a linear water feature and a sculptural olive tree in warm afternoon light
posts.hook: Most builders disappear at the final payment. We come back at month ten.
posts.caption:
Anyone can make a space look good on handover day. The real question is whether it still looks like this two summers later.

That's why every project includes The 10-Month Walk-Through — we come back, on our own, and go over the whole space with a fine-toothed comb before the first year is out. Settling, grout, drainage, finishes. We'd rather catch it than have you find it.

The selections:
• Belgard Porcelain pavers
• ipe wood ceiling
• linear water feature
• FX Luminaire lighting
• sculptural olive & coastal plantings

Want a firm that's still around at month ten? DM “DESIGN”.
